tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lam 'bras 'chad skabs kyi tho chung bzhugs so// shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras gyi dmigs khrid tho yig las/ slob mas chos rim rjes la slob dpon gyis 'dren mchog bla ma kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ ces yan lag bdun pa byed par bshad/ snang gsum mdzes rgyan nas 'byung ba ltar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum blo nus dus skabs dang bstun la skyabs 'gro la dmigs thun gcig ma dag snang ba'i grang dmyal brgyad la gcig tsha dmyal brgyad la gcig nyi tshe nye 'khor ba la gcig yi dwags la gcig dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la gcig spyir 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang khyad par mi'i 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la gcig lha dang lha min 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la gcig 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la gcig dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa dang phan 'dogs che ba bsam pa la gcig thob pa'i dal ba yun du gnas min bsam ba la gcig nges par 'chi ba bsam pa la gcig nam 'chi nges med bsam pa la gcig chos min phan med bsam pa la gcig blang dor ston pa dkar nag las 'bras khrid la gcig mi dge'i las 'bras bsam pa gcig dge ba'i las 'bras bsam pa la gcig lung ma bstan gyi las bsam pa la gcig ste ma dag pa'i snang ba la dmigs thun bco lnga bya'o/ /nyams kyi snang ba la byams pa bsgom pa la gcig snying rje bsgom pa la gcig byang sems bsgom pa la smon pa sems bskyed la gcig 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi bdag gzhan mnyam pa la gcig brje ba la gcig de dag spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu la bslab pa la gcig zhi lhag zung 'brel don dam byang sems bsgom pa la gcig zhi gnas la gcig lhag mthong la gcig zung 'brel la gcig skye 'gyur gyi nyams la nges shes bsgom pa la gcig ste nyams kyi snang ba la dmigs thun bcu bya'o/ /dag pa'i snang ba la dmigs thun gcig dang bcas pa'i dmigs thun nyi shu rtsa bdun byed pa ni rgyas pa'o/

/'bring du byed na/ dmyal ba la gcig yi dwags la gcig dud 'gro la gcig 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal la gcig 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la gcig dal 'byor rnyed dka' la gcig phan 'dogs che ba la gcig yun du gnas min bsam pa la gcig mi dge ba'i las 'bras bsam pa la gcig dge ba'i las 'bras bsam pa dang lung ma bstan gyi las bsam pa la gcig ste dmigs thun dgu bya'o/ /nyams kyi snang ba la byams pa la gcig snying rje la gcig smon pa la gcig bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang brje ba la gcig de dag gi spyod pa bslab pa la gcig don dam byang sems kyi zhi gnas la gcig lhag mthong dang zung 'brel skye 'gyur gyi nyams rgol ba la gcig ste bdun bya'o/ /dag pa'i snang ba la gcig dang bcas pas bco brgyad do/ /bsdus pa la/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa gcig 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la gcig 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la gcig dal 'byor rnyed dka' la gcig las 'bras bsam pa la gcig ste/ ma dag pa'i snang ba la dmigs thun lnga bya/ nyams kyi snang ba la byas pa dang snying rje gnyis la gcig zhi lhag gnyis la gcig smon 'jug gnyis la gcig zung 'brel dang skye 'gyur gyi nyams la gcig ste dmigs thun bzhi bya/ dag pa'i snang ba la gcig dang bcas pa'i dmigs thun bcu gcig bya'o/ /dmigs thun de rnams kyi grangs la skyabs 'gro la dmigs thun re re byed pa gsum char la 'dra bas/ skyabs 'gro the ba'i dmigs thun grangs de bzhin 'byung ba yin pas de dag skabs dang sbyar la bshad/ de'i nyi ma rjes ma'i snga chos la/ sems bskyed gtor ma zlum gtor gcig ltung bshags tshar gsum song rjes/ lus kyi las ni rnam pa gsum zhes sogs dang / thog ma med nas da lta'i bar zhes dang / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni zhes dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / zhes pa rnams shlo ka re re lan gsum gsum/

slob dpon khri la 'khod nas slob ma rnams kyi chos rim bya/ de'i sgang la me tog bkye bsdu bya/ de'i phyi dro slob ma rjes 'dzin la'ang yig brgya dang chos gtor sogs bshad/ dkar mo sogs dang / mi bskyod rdo rje sogs ma bshad/ lha yi sogs nas kun 'grub shog oṃ sogs nas muḥyi mthar/ 'dir bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig swā hā/ zhes brjod la mtheb srin gyi se gol sogs/ de nas slob dpon gyis mdun du dul bar sogs/ sngags lam bsrung 'khor bsdu tshe/ hūm̐ dang pos/ thun mong gi srung 'khor rtsibs bcu pa la bsdu/ gnyis pa brjod pa'i tshe 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa khro bo bcu la bsdu/ gsum pa brjod pa'i tshe khro bo bcu dbus kyi gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bsdu/ rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan ltar las/ bskyed rim gyi skabs su man ngag rnams bshad nas 'byung ba ltar gyi mngon rtogs kyi go don rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs par blo nus dus skabs sogs dang sbyar nas 'chad pa yin la/ rgyud gsum gyi dmigs rkang grangs kyang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ de dag ji ltar yin brda don gsal ba'i dmigs rim rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum brda tshig gi tshul gyis gsungs pa'i don 'grel pa la gnyis te/ brda tshig tshul gyis gsungs tshul dang / de'i don bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni gsang ba'i sgo 'byed las khrid tshul rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum po/ kun la sogs dang / chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung las gnyis las gsum 'byung zhes bya ba/ gnas skabs gzhan du gzhan gsung yang / /thun mong min par gsungs pa ni/ /nye ring brgyud tshul bgrod pa las/ /zab don snying po yon tan 'byung / /klus bsgyur phyogs ni bu ga bcas/ /dang po'i grangs yin mes bsgyur phyogs/ /yon tan gyis lhag bar pa ste/

/phyi ma bu gar shes par bya/ /'di dag blta ba bskyed rdzogs kyi/ /don gyi gnad rnams bsdus pa ste/ bla ma mchog la rag las phyir/ /kun gyi spyod yul ma yin pas/ /phyi nang mu stegs kun la gsang / /shin tu bsdus pa dbang bzhi'i lam/ /gdan thog gcig la logs shig tu/ /rtsa ba'i tshig gis bstan pa ste/ des na 'khrid tshul chu gter ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa de'i don bshad pa ni/ rgyas pa'i skabs su sngon 'gro yon tan gsum/ lta ri me ni so bdun/ bskyed rim re gza' bdun/ rlung thub pa yang bdun/ gtum mo nyes pa bco brgyad/ zhu bde klu brgyad/ rba rlabs bu ga bdun/ bsdoms na gya dgu/ klus bsgyur phyogs ni bu gar bcas/ /zhes pas so/ /'bring la sngon 'gro 'jig rten gsum/ lta ba mtsho bzhi/ bskyed rim rtse mo gsum/ rlung ri bo bdun/ gtum mo thub pa'ang bdun/ zhu bde mtsho bzhi/ rba rlabs 'byung ba lnga/ bsdoms pas so gsum ste/ mes bsgyur phyogs/ yon tan gyis lhag pa'o/ /bsdus pa/ sngon 'gro rtse mo gsum/ lta ba nas rba rlabs kyi bar thams cad ri bong can te gcig go /bsdoms na dgu ste phyi ma bu gar shes par bya/ zhes so/ /'di dag ni lam gyi dngos gzhi'i sogs ni mi rung ba ni ma yin pas/ rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi nang bzhin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ston dgos so/ /'pho ba bar do sogs/ de ltar phyi bskyed rim la dmigs thun rgyas pa la sum cu rtsa gcig dang / 'bring po la chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i dgongs pa bzhin bcu gnyis bya'o/ /des na 'dir bshad pa'i dmigs pa rgyas par spro na dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa rgyas pa la dmigs thun sngar gyi brgyad cu rtsa dgu'i steng du bskyed rim sum cu rtsa gnyis bsnan pas dmigs thun brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gcig 'byung la/ 'bring la sngar gyi sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi steng du bskyed rim gyi bcu gnyis bsnan pas bzhi bcu zhe lnga/

bsdus pa la bskyed rim bstan du yod pa tsam mo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang chos smra ba'i btsun pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis chos grwa chen po e waṃ chos ldan du thor bkod pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ lam 'bras 'chad skabs kyi tho chung / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
